protocol.describe(split): Student-visible task, public contracts and bounded JSON probe schema; split train or holdout; no private labels.
protocol.lesson(): Generic teaching JSON with preconditions, exploration method, oracle and non-examples; no holdout answer key.
protocol.evaluate(probe, split=...): Fresh local state -> status violation/passed/error, stable signature, measurements with receipts and committed effects.
protocol.control(probe, split=...): Matched control preserving target and other conditions, removing timeout fault.
protocol.novelty(probe): Host-side substantive-condition check for held-out result delivery, read freshness or replay identity; not mere renamed inputs.

evidence_classes.frozen-native.json: Verified historical native counterexample; current offline replay and source verification only.
evidence_classes.evaluate: Current deterministic local policy-fixture observation, not native Hermes or live model behavior.
evidence_classes.local-validation.json: Offline teacher/probe-fixture/host validation, not student learning.

host_only: suite source and private policy mapping
runtime_scope: All side effects are local synthetic export records. No network, credentials, shell or model client inside this suite.
main_runner_responsibilities: Two fresh teacher/positive replays and a passing matched control
Shared model budget and source identity
Keep failures, negatives and inconclusive observations
